metadata.title: Urban Soul Portrait with Textured Typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a man in a vibrant orange leather jacket and aviators, set against a heavily textured, painterly background of ochre and rust tones. The composition features a prominent, expressive hand-drawn script logo in the lower right corner, layered over a clean sans-serif subtitle.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochromatic warmth between the subject's jacket and the abstract background
Contrast between the sharp, high-gloss leather and the gritty, matte wall texture
Dynamic tension between the fluid, organic script and the rigid, geometric sans-serif type
coreInvariants: Subject wearing dark aviator sunglasses looking downward
Layered background containing faint, distressed typographic elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centrally framed medium shot, subject occupies the middle two-thirds of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The high-sheen orange leather jacket serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face/sunglasses, moves down the jacket to the clasped hands, and terminates at the large white script in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the background is filled with texture and ghosted lettering to maintain high energy.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm Ochre and Burnt Orange (Background and Jacket)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep Indigo/Blue (Denim jeans at the bottom)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the oranges; high contrast between the dark sunglasses/shadows and the bright white text.
paletteRestrictions: Limit the palette to warm earth tones, white, and denim blue

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Fluid, gestural script paired with a wide, modern sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Primary name: Hand-drawn with a dry-brush texture, featuring long, sweeping descenders and a circular dot over the 'j'.
Secondary text: Geometric sans-serif with open counters and uniform stroke weight.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'j' in the script acts as a vertical framing element for the secondary text.
The 'e' in the script has an exaggerated, open loop.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Expressive organic script contrasted with functional geometric sans-serif.

preserve: The sweeping descender of the first letter

candidateDirections.reason: To match the raw, hand-painted energy of the main title.
Provides the necessary geometric stability for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man with a shaved head wearing dark aviators and a glossy orange leather jacket. The background should be a textured, abstract wall with layers of ochre, rust, and faint, distressed stencil-style lettering. Lighting should be warm and directional.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, white, hand-drawn brush script in the bottom right corner. Nest a two-line, lowercase, bold geometric sans-serif subtitle within the curve of the script's first letter.

verificationChecks: Is the orange jacket the most saturated element?
Does the script text have a dry-brush texture?
Is the subtitle lowercase and geometric?
Is the background sufficiently distressed and layered?

adjustableVariables: Sheen level of the leather jacket
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Any recognizable brand logos on the watch or clothing
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the white text is legible against the orange background.
Check that the subject's pose feels contemplative and soulful.
Verify the background lettering is abstract enough not to distract from the main subject.
Confirm the denim blue at the bottom provides a grounded base for the composition.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Soul Aesthetic = (Warm Earth Tones + Glossy Leather) * (Distressed Painterly Background) + (Hand-drawn Script / Geometric Sans-serif)
